quests.title: Strange Stone Chronicle

dialogue.t: Puca, we're back!
{NICKNAME} and Paimon! Are you here to play with me?
Um, not really! You told us that we could ask you anything related to ore veins and gemstones, right?
Yep! I've collected all the pretty stones around the area. What exactly do you wanna ask about?
It's about that stone we found last time...

dialogue.sit: You tell Puca about how you sold the strange ore to the gemstone merchant...

dialogue.t: Huh? People outside really thought that it was a precious gemstone? But I've even shown it to my sister before... Humans really are hard to understand...
But I know a lot of places with stones like this! If you want, I'll show you where they are.

dialogue.sit: Puca marks the locations of the strange ore on your map.

dialogue.t: That'll be great. Thanks, Puca! Oh, right, here's the Mora that Chesil paid us as an advance fee. We could give you half, y'know!
Oh, it's alright. We don't really need anything like that in the village, anyway... not to mention how you've helped me so much, too!
Welcome... Oh hey, it's you!
Do you have the ore you agreed to bring?
Well, the craftsmen are still processing the previous sample, so it's not too urgent...
But if we managed to get our hands on more supplies, the craftsmen might just become newly inspired, eh?
I'll still be here waiting for your good news.
Welcome... Oh hey, it's you! My gemstone suppliers...
Yup! We brought lots of that ore, as promised!
Whoa, you found so much... This is an enormous help!

I already sent the ore to the workshop, but I still haven't received my sample product yet. It could be because the artisans aren't familiar with working a gem of this kind and ran into some trouble...
But worry not! I trust my judgment.
I'm planning to turn them into accessories that'll no doubt become the newest craze all across Fontaine.
You'll see what the final product looks like the next time you visit! I'll give you some samples as a gift when the time comes.
Or perhaps... you might see the most fashionable of the nobility wearing them before you even arrive, haha.
Alright then, you're always welcome to come back another time.
Welcome! We meet again.
The ore you brought last time is still being processed at the moment, so I cannot show you the finished product yet. I'm afraid you must wait a bit longer...

quests.description: In order to find Puca’s token, you once again visit the vein from before…
